heat.name: Urban heat islands — WBGT mean
heat.note: Heat-stress proxy, not a continuous air-temperature measurement. The authoritative metadata defines pixels as normalized 0–100 WBGT indicator values for 24 August 2016 and permits reuse under CC BY 4.0 with source attribution. The approximately 19 MB ZIP is not committed; heat-preview.png is a downsampled visual preview.

canopy.name: Urban Vegetation Data — Canopy Height Model
canopy.note: Useful canopy/vegetation layer, but the full shapefile is large and is not committed to this prototype.

mobility.name: Brussels bicycle counters
mobility.note: A mobility proxy. Counters are sparse and are not equivalent to general pedestrian street use.
